stage: 4L11 Multiple backbuffers, FLIP pixels and retained chain storage
changes: Allocate distinct cached buffers 1/2 for implicit and additional chains; retain fixed public surface identities while rotating contents with GPU copies.
Preserve a hidden front buffer for FLIP; COPY preserves contents, DISCARD contents remain unspecified.
All cached public references and bindings participate in parent lifetime; unused implicit caches do not block Reset and are destroyed under a temporary device pin.
A renderable LockRect readback shadow no longer removes its GPU identity; subsequent binding and StretchRect remain valid.
